     Issuance Date:       October 27, 2016

            Purpose:      This bulletin rescinds 22 Memoranda (memos), 1 letter, 2 directives, and 5 Operations Policy
                          and Procedure Notices (OPPNs) that are no longer applicable under any code.

          Subject(s):     Memo, rescinded; Letter, rescinded; Directive, rescinded; OPPN, rescinded.


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs), Policy and
Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various memoranda, directives, and
letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department practice and incorporate new laws and
regulations.

Effective immediately, the following documents are to be rescinded:
 Memorandum dated 5/14/69 – Re: Boiler Inspection Flame Safeguards – Industrial Rule No. 4
 Directive 18 of 1969 – Re: Water Supply Connection between Boilers P107.14
 Memorandum dated 1/26/70 – Re: Inspections for Emergency Repairs
